purpose: C5 (notes/008, owner's change): IBM Heron noise parameters from internet-published data only; no backend, no API call, no live calibration, no qiskit fake-backend snapshot

conventions.errors: IBM's per-gate 'error' values are the randomized-benchmarking error per gate (average gate infidelity); readout error = assignment error averaged over |0> and |1> (P(0|1) and P(1|0) given separately where published).
conventions.medians: IBM's public numbers are medians over qubits/edges unless stated; paper snapshots quote what the authors read and do not always say median vs mean (stated per value).

platform.title: IBM Quantum Platform - Compute resources (public, signed-out table)
platform.source_date: live page, read 2026-10-21 (no sign-in; the per-QPU detail panel needs the API and was not used)

proc_types.title: IBM Quantum documentation - Processor types (Heron r2: 156 qubits, heavy-hexagonal lattice; r3 July 2025)

frac.title: IBM Quantum documentation - Fractional gates (Heron basis gates cz, id, rz, sx, x; with fractional gates also rx, rzz)

qdc2025.title: IBM Quantum blog, Scaling for quantum advantage and beyond (QDC 2025): Heron r3 176 two-qubit couplings, 330 000 CLOPS

patra2026.title: A. K. Patra et al., Machine-Learned Compact Subspace Generation for QSCI within DMET, arXiv:2607.20585, App. A Tables A1 (ibm_boston, Heron r3) and A2 (ibm_fez, Heron r2)

kingston2026.title: Quantifying the Hadamard Resilience Effect and the Coherence Gap in NISQ-Era Classifiers, arXiv:2605.10638, Sec. III (ibm_kingston, Heron r2, medians at execution time)

kingston_jun2026.title: Perfect and peak state transfer on IBM quantum hardware, arXiv:2610.20855, Sec. 5.3 (ibm_kingston calibration of 2026-06-12)

pitt2026.title: Practical Entanglement Distillation Protocols with Quadratic Error Suppression, arXiv:2605.26757, App. A (IBM Research Zurich; ibm_pittsburgh, Heron r3): 2q gate 88 ns, 1q gate 32 ns, readout 2584 ns

gambetta2025.title: J. Gambetta (IBM) post announcing ibm_pittsburgh, Heron r3: T1 300 us, T2 370 us, 2Q error ~5e-4 (best), layered error 3.2e-3
gambetta2025.accessed: 2026-10-21 (via search-engine snippet; the post itself was not fetched)

definitions.2Q_error_best: lowest two-qubit error over all edges (isolated RB)
definitions.2Q_error_layered_EPLG: average two-qubit error per layered gate for a 100-qubit chain

topology.value: heavy-hexagonal lattice, 156 qubits; 176 couplers (8 rows of 16 qubits + 7 x 4 bridge qubits)
topology.qualification: row/bridge structure: our reconstruction consistent with 156 qubits and the 176 couplings quoted for Heron (qdc2025); exact bridge columns not published outside the API

native_gates.qualification: fractional rx, rzz optional (not used here)

sx_duration.qualification: measured on ibm_pittsburgh (Heron r3); single-qubit gate length on Heron, assumed equal on r2

T1.qualification: ibm_boston pre-execution snapshot 2026-05-02 13:34 IST (Table A1, last column); five earlier snapshots 274-280 us

cz_error.qualification: same snapshot; range over the six snapshots 1.098e-3 .. 1.220e-3

cz_duration.qualification: ibm_pittsburgh (also r3) reports an 88 ns 2q gate (pitt2026): durations differ per device
